caseName: A. J. Paretta Contracting Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: A. J. PARETTA CONTRACTING CO., INC. v. United States

opinions.text:
Government contract; increase of minimum wage-rates for carpenters at request of contractor and for its benefit. Judgment for plaintiff.

Plaintiff’s petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court February 12, 1948.
